title: UG Semester IV Final Examination Schedule
description: Detailed routine for BA/BSc/BCom Honours and General Semester IV examinations starting from September 10, 2026.

title: Publication of 1st Merit List for UG Admissions
description: The first merit list for BA/BSc/BCom Honours will be published on August 14, 2026, at 4:00 PM.

title: Commencement of Semester III Classes
description: Regular classes for all UG Semester III students will commence from August 10, 2026. Students are advised to check the departmental notice boards for routines.

title: NIT for Supply of Laboratory Equipment (Physics Dept)
description: Sealed quotations are invited from reputed suppliers for providing laboratory equipment for the Physics Department.

title: Observance of Independence Day 2026
description: Flag hoisting ceremony will be held on August 15 at 8:30 AM in the college campus. All staff and students are requested to attend.

title: Form Fill-up for Semester IV Exams
description: Online form fill-up portal for Semester IV will remain open from July 22 to July 30, 2026.
